Every clause of Lemma 7.7 is stated in Lean, for the same general objects, under hypotheses that are the paper's own standing rules ((6.32), Lemma 7.1) made explicit. (7.38), r_m ∈ W_{α+1/2−κ}, exact divergence-freeness, (7.39)'s identity and class bound, and the support/smoothness clause are six theorems of CurlClassBounds.lean plus HarmonicCalculus.longitudinal_identity; C_m ∈ W_{α+1/2} is stated in the label-uniform and localized class wrappers elsewhere; the physical prefactors Q^{1/2−A}, Q^{−2A} are definitions. findings.summary: No declaration bundling Lemma 7.7 was found. Its clauses are seven theorems: (7.38), r_m's class, divergence, (7.39)'s identity and class, supports in CurlClassBounds.lean/HarmonicCalculus.lean; C_m ∈ W_{α+1/2} only in other files' class frameworks.

The lemma's last sentence is a definitional convention in Lean, not an asserted conclusion: the physical potential and pressure are defined as Q^{−h} and Q^{−2A} times the chart ones, with h = A − 1/2.
